scripts.check: npm run check:core && npm run e2e -- --workers=1
scripts.check:core: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:web && npm run test:api && npm run contracts:check && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@cortex/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@cortex/web
scripts.lint: eslint . && uv run --directory services/api --frozen ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@cortex/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace=@cortex/web && uv run --directory services/api --frozen mypy
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --directory services/api --frozen python scripts/export_openapi.py && openapi-typescript services/api/openapi.json -o packages/contracts/src/generated/openapi.ts
